### Diff-aware (automatic when on a feature branch with no URL)

Browser sessions are the slowest and most expensive part of QA, so launch the browser only when the diff can change what renders.

```bash
git diff <base>...HEAD --name-only | grep -E '^(app/views|app/components|src/components|src/pages|public)/|\.(css|scss|html|tsx|jsx|vue|erb)$'
```

- **Matches found:** map the matching files to pages, find the running app, and test those pages in the browser.
- **No matches:** do not launch the browser. Run the project's test command (`bun test`, `npm test`, `pytest`, or the command in CLAUDE.md) and any eval suite covering the changed files, then report the results as the QA outcome.
